description: Lint-opinion rules with no upstream authority source

SK006.description: Skill body exceeds token warning threshold (4400 tokens)
SK006.rationale: The 4400-token warning threshold is an empirical observation about context-window pressure, not a vendor-specified limit. No upstream spec or schema defines a maximum skill body token count.

SK007.description: Skill body exceeds token error threshold (8800 tokens) — must split
SK007.rationale: The 8800-token error threshold is an empirical observation about when skill bodies become unwieldy, not a vendor-specified limit. No upstream spec or schema defines a maximum skill body token count.

SK005.description: Skill description must contain at least one trigger phrase (e.g., 'use when', 'use this', 'trigger', 'activate')
SK005.rationale: Trigger phrases enable the model to decide when to auto-load a skill. No vendor schema or spec defines a required set of trigger phrases. The specific phrase list is a lint opinion.
SK005.constraint: Description must contain at least one of: 'use when', 'use this', 'use on', 'used when', 'used by', 'when ', 'trigger', 'activate', 'load this', 'load when', 'invoke'

FM004.description: Multiline YAML syntax (block scalars |, >, |-, >-) in description field should be avoided
FM004.rationale: No vendor schema restricts multiline syntax in the description field. Claude Code runtime accepts it. This is a style preference for readability and portability.
FM004.constraint: Description field should use a single-line string, not a YAML block scalar or folded scalar

FM010.name_pattern.description: Skill name must match regex ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$ — lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphens
FM010.name_pattern.rationale: The agentskills.io schema enforces maxLength=64 but does not specify a regex pattern for the name field. The lowercase-alphanumeric-with-hyphens pattern and the consecutive-hyphen prohibition have no vendor source; they are lint opinions based on convention.
FM010.name_pattern.constraint: Name must match ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$ and must not contain consecutive hyphens (--)

FM007.claude_code_tool_fields.description: FM007 also inspects the Claude Code agent frontmatter fields `tools` and `disallowedTools`
FM007.claude_code_tool_fields.rationale: The AgentSkills specification declares only `allowed-tools` (tracked as the provenance claim FM007.tool_field_names). `packages/skilllint/schemas/claude_code/v1.json` declares `tools` but not `disallowedTools`, which comes from the sub-agents.md prose reference and appears in no packaged schema. With no vendor file covering both, this portion of the field set has no drift-checkable source and is recorded here rather than as a provenance claim.
FM007.claude_code_tool_fields.constraint: FM007 inspects `tools` and `disallowedTools` in addition to the specification's `allowed-tools`

SK004.min_description_length.description: Skill description shorter than the 20-character minimum
SK004.min_description_length.rationale: The 20-character minimum description length is a quality heuristic, not a spec requirement. The agentskills.io schema sets minLength=1 for description; the 20-char threshold is a lint opinion for description quality.
SK004.min_description_length.constraint: _MIN_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH = 20 (characters); the 1024 maximum is schema-backed (see provenance registry SK004.max_description_length)

HK004.description: Hook script referenced in hooks.json by a command-type hook entry does not exist on disk
HK004.rationale: Claude Code's hooks docs describe the mechanism (a command-type hook spawns the script at the given path) but never name a missing script as a documented failure mode with vendor-specified behavior. Checking that the referenced file exists is skilllint's own robustness check, not a claim traceable to an upstream spec.
HK004.constraint: A command-type hook entry's file-path command (starting with ./, ../, /, or ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/) must resolve to an existing file
